edges: Chad made its first appearance at the Summer Olympics.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Chad has had no medalists in the Beijing Olympics.
Moumi Sébergué and Hinikissia Albertine Ndikert were part of the same delegation representing Chad in the 2008 Summer Olympics.
Kaltouma Nadjina represented Chad in the 2004 Summer Olympics, while Moumi Sébergué was part of the delegation in the 2008 Summer Olympics.
Chad has had no medalists at the London Olympics.
Hinikissia Albertine Ndikert competed on Chad's behalf as the national delegation's only female athlete at the Beijing games.
